marketplace.deploymentMethod: staging/direct-upload; production served by separately managed Cloudflare Worker
marketplace.productionNote: Production app.bietalreef.ae and www.app.bietalreef.ae route to Cloudflare Worker bietalreef-marketplace. This repository is still prototype-only, with zero Cloudflare Worker Git build triggers; do not publish it to production before feature parity, commerce/auth tests, and rollback readiness.

admin.deployMethod: GitHub Actions direct Cloudflare Pages upload (workflow configured in admin repository)

legacyMarketplace.role: Deleted Cloudflare Pages project; no active Git source or Pages deployments remain for this project.
legacyMarketplace.note: Cloudflare API DELETE appbietalreef returned HTTP 200; subsequent project listing excluded appbietalreef and direct GET returned HTTP 404 (Project not found). Original GitHub repository is not deleted.

namingNote: markplec is the exact existing marketplace GitHub repository name. Production worker and repository are not yet wired into a verified Git-driven release; do not infer production from repository presence.
